data.one_liner: Decode non-symbolic stack traces from AOT-compiled Dart apps using stored debugging info
data.what_it_does: This package reads debugging information (DWARF, PDB, Mach‑O) and translates raw stack traces that contain only program counters into symbolic stack traces with file, function, and line numbers. It also provides a CLI tool to perform the translation on error logs.
use_when: You ship an AOT‑compiled Dart app and want to debug crashes on production devices
You need to map stack traces back to source code after stripping debug info
You want a command‑line tool to translate logs offline
avoid_when: You are not using AOT compilation or your stack traces already contain symbols
You need a general-purpose stack‑trace library for runtime error handling
strengths: Supports multiple binary formats (PE/COFF, Mach‑O, ELF) and DWARF/PDB
weaknesses: Limited to non‑symbolic stack traces only
Requires access to the original debugging files
data.setup_notes: Add dependency and run `dart pub global activate native_stack_traces` for CLI, or import library in code
